completed.summary: Convert courses listing page from light theme (white cards, #aafbb2 green) to GTO Wizard dark design system: var(--panel) cards, var(--border) borders, var(--green) (#00C853) accents, var(--text)/var(--muted) text. Updated stats summary, filter panel, course cards, sidebar, loading/error states. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Fixed progress endpoint 500 error (UserProgressResponse.id Optional[str]), restarted API to populate lesson content with real markdown. Course detail page shows lessons with content, progress tracking works end-to-end (mark complete, view progress). 387 tests pass, build clean, live 200.
Replaced Math.random() bar heights with real selectedHandData.equity values. Bar height = Math.max(4, equity * 55), showing actual per-hand equity from solver API.

Created /leaderboard page with period filter (all-time/weekly/daily), table with rank/player/score/accuracy/hands/EV-loss columns, current user highlight with YOU badge, medal icons for top 3, empty/error/loading states. Added period filter support to GET /api/v1/quiz/leaderboard backend. 368 tests pass, build clean, live returns 200 with 0 JS errors.

Postflop action selection feedback: selected button highlights with green border/glow, GTO-recommended action shows ✓ GTO badge, feedback text below action row shows 'Correct!' or 'Suboptimal (EV gap: X.X bb)', 'Try Again' button resets selection, 'Continue to Next Street' button advances street. Unselected buttons disabled after pick. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Timed Drill mode: per-spot countdown timer (configurable 30s/60s/120s) with visual ⏱️ indicator, auto-advance on expiry (records as incorrect), response time tracking with speed bonus scoring (up to +50 pts per spot), drill summary with Score/Avg Time/Accuracy. Timer duration selector in setup. Spaced Repetition shows 'coming soon' notice. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Verified right sidebar analysis tabs are fully implemented: Overview/Table/Equity chart main tabs, Hand/Summary/Filters/Actions/Blockers sub-tabs, aggregate action frequencies with combo counts, card removal analysis. Already committed in d980026. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200. Advancing to next task.
